God's Mission +God's Word

Read the Word. Join God's Mission.

MissioWord is a formation ministry that helps believers and churches read the whole Bible as the story of God's mission, recover their missional identity, and form others for faithful participation.

Why MissioWord

Not a resource library. A formation ministry.

MissioWord is not limited to one book of the Bible. It is a way of reading the whole Bible through the mission of God.

The Need

We read the Bible, but often fail to connect it to God's mission story — or to our own place within it.

Our Conviction

The whole Bible, from creation to new creation, is the story of God's mission.

Our Difference

Not resources to consume, but people and churches formed to reproduce — from personal devotion to church planting and unreached peoples.

See the Vision in 2 Minutes — what missional Bible reading is, and why it matters for God's mission.

The Method

Missional Bible Reading

Genesis and Exodus are the fruit of this method — not the whole of it. The method itself can be applied to any passage of Scripture.

Two Foundations

Historical Grounding

Careful attention to each passage's historical, literary, and theological meaning.

Transcendent Meaning

Reading each passage within the whole of Scripture and the mission of the Triune God.

Three Perspectives

Read every passage through three perspectives, together within the work of the Triune God.

01 · God-Centered

What does this reveal about God?

Reads the passage first for God's character, will, and mission — and asks how our lives should respond to that God.

02 · Christ-Centered

How is this fulfilled in Jesus?

Reads the passage within God's whole redemptive story, tracing how it is fulfilled in the mission of God accomplished in Christ.

03 · Spirit-Centered

How does the Spirit lead us to respond?

Connects the rightly-understood text to today's life and community under the Spirit's guidance, leading the church into God's mission.

The Missio Dei Framework

One center holds the whole method together: Missio Dei — joining God in His mission, read through three perspectives at once.

See The 6R Formation Pathway

The whole journey, in one shape: Read → Reframe → Raise Up → Reproduce → Reach Out → Renew.

1

Read — Read and Reflect on the Word

Read the text closely, then reflect on what it means for your life and community.

2

Reframe — Through Three Perspectives

Reread the passage as God-Centered, Christ-Centered, and Spirit-Centered — fresh, within God's mission.

3

Raise Up — Raise Up Missional Leaders

Those who respond are trained and equipped to live and lead on mission.

4

Reproduce — Within the Community

Trained leaders teach the word again, raising up new disciples and leaders.

5

Reach Out — To the World

Formed communities carry the gospel into churches, mission fields, and unreached peoples.

6

Renew — Review and Renew the Cycle

Reflect on what happened, then begin the next cycle wider and deeper.

The 6R pathway starts with personal reflection, but it doesn't stop there — the Word forms people, people form community, and community is sent out again to the nations.

The Resources

Seven-Step Gospel Picture

Street evangelism tool · Draw one simple picture, sentence by sentence, from Creation to God's Kingdom · English video, illustrated overview, and printable worksheet

A seven-step picture, drawn one piece at a time in an ordinary conversation — no training or materials required beyond a pen and paper. Each step pairs one simple line to draw with one short sentence to say, carrying the whole gospel story from Creation to the fulfillment of God's Kingdom.
